candidateName.title: Candidate Name
candidateName.description: The name or part of the name of the candidate to bookmark.

evaluationId.title: Evaluation Id
evaluationId.description: The Id or number (for example EVAL-00003) of a saved evaluation. Use only if you already have it.

notes.title: Notes
notes.description: Optional notes from the recruiter to save with the bookmark, in the recruiter's own words.

roleName.title: Role Name
roleName.description: The role the candidate was evaluated for, or part of its title. Leave empty if only one role was evaluated.
